_doc: History tile series from an attribute or weather.get_forecasts (eink-ha-os#283): emulator src/core/history.ts (historySource, historyError, historySpec, parseTime, attrSamples, fromSamples, chartSpan / axisTicks with aheadMs). Firmware: core/history.cpp, core/history_series.cpp (eink-ha-os#292), test_core test_history_series_vectors. Times are epoch ms; tz = local UTC offset in minutes. config: like config/*.json. spec: historySpec (aheadMs and source only for these sources). parseTime: input, tz → ms or null. series: raw attribute → samples → buckets per agg, plus the span and the axis.

config.name: series-attribute
config.description: An attribute series: any sensor / binary_sensor / weather entity; value and time name the entry fields; ahead 0…window. Keys kept as written.

expect.yaml:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    app: home
    title: a
    widgets:
      - {type: history, entity: binary_sensor.rain_expected, attribute: forecast, value: precipitation, window: 2h, bucket: 5m, cs: 4}
      - {type: history, entity: sensor.rain_nowcast, attribute: forecast, value: precipitation, time: datetime, window: 4h, ahead: 2h, bucket: 10m, cs: 4}
  - id: b
    app: home
    title: b
    widgets:
      - {type: history, entity: sensor.prices, attribute: today, window: 24h, ahead: 0, style: bars, cs: 4}

config.name: series-forecast
config.description: A weather entity without attribute reads weather.get_forecasts (hourly by default; daily).

      - {type: history, entity: weather.home, window: 24h, cs: 4}

config.name: series-attr-wrong-domain
config.description: Rule: an attribute series reads a sensor / binary_sensor / weather entity.
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:

    widgets:
      - {type: history, entity: light.kitchen, attribute: forecast}

expect.message: history: “light.kitchen” is not a sensor / binary_sensor / weather entity

config.name: series-forecast-on-recorder
config.description: Rule: forecast only on a weather entity (an input_number is a recorder series).
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: history, entity: input_number.target, forecast: daily}

expect.message: history: forecast needs an attribute or a weather entity

config.name: series-bad-field

series.name: nowcast-ahead
series.description: Rain nowcast, the next 2 h in 5-minute bars: the first bucket holds now; entries before it are outside; a null value is skipped.

series.name: nowcast-around
series.description: The same list ±2 h in 10-minute bars (ahead 2h): the bucket holding now starts the second half; two samples per bucket.

series.name: nowcast-json-string
series.description: The list as a JSON string (how the firmware stream keeps list attributes), 30-minute bars, agg max.

series.name: plain-numbers
series.description: A list of plain numbers: one per bucket from the bucket holding now; text that is not a number is skipped (a gap).

series.name: plain-numbers-past
series.description: Plain numbers with ahead 0 (the recorder span): only the first lands in the last (open) bucket.

series.name: weather-hourly
series.description: weather.get_forecasts hourly, temperature, 24 h in 1-hour bars on a 2-wide tile (local times with +01:00).

series.name: weather-hourly-change
series.description: Hourly precipitation summed per 6 h (agg change = sum of the samples).

series.name: weather-daily
series.description: weather.get_forecasts daily, 7 days of 1-day bars, max temperature; daily times at 11:00 UTC.

series.name: not-a-list
series.description: An attribute that is not a list (or JSON text of one) has no samples.

both.name: rain-bars
both.description: Rain: 1 h of the gauge (max per 10 min) before the bucket holding now, then 2 h of the nowcast; an unavailable row leaves its bucket empty.

both.name: rain-line
both.description: The same as a line (mean): the forecast line starts at the last past point.

both.name: rain-step
both.description: Step: the forecast starts with the upright join at the Now edge.

both.name: rain-dots-no-past
both.description: Dots without past rows (the gauge has no history): the past buckets are gaps, forecast dots hollow.
